title: Follow the product-standards planning flow (apc standards plan -> set -> validate)
prompt:
TinyFX (plugins/TinyFX) is a simple free effect plugin that is entering the /apc-plan phase. Its status.json has no "standards" block yet.

Use the APC standards CLI -- do not hand-edit status.json and do not touch schemas/apc-standards.json:
1. Run `apc standards plan --plugin TinyFX` and read the questions.
2. Answer every REQUIRED question with `apc standards set <id> <value> --plugin TinyFX`. Facts about TinyFX: it is an effect, so presets are flat (no typed sound/kit tree); user data lives per-user (not machine-wide); the license mode is free.
3. Finish with `apc standards validate --plugin TinyFX`, which must exit 0.

Optional questions may keep their registry defaults.

checks.description: apc standards validate --plugin TinyFX exits 0 (all required answered, nothing unknown)
schemas/apc-standards.json is byte-identical to the repo's locked registry
